data.name: Analyst Who Ignites Tycoon's Desire
data.detailed_description:
Analyst Who Ignites Tycoon's Desire - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction
In the midsummer of 2023, in Shanghai's Lujiazui, female analyst SUKI faced a choice at Renhe Capital. To treat her mother with liver cancer, she signed a gray document and got involved in the capital vortex ever since. At the company meeting, she stood out with her professional ability but also developed a complicated relationship with Wu Shiren and gradually stepped into an abyss of no return.
Worldview atmosphere
The story unfolds around the bustling financial city of Shanghai. Renhe Capital controls a huge amount of gray funds. The workplace competition is fierce, and power and interests are intertwined. There is both the superficial glamour and the unknown dark deals, creating a tense and exciting atmosphere.
Highlights of female character interactions
SUKI had a direct confrontation with Zhao Na, Wu Shiren's wife, at the hilltop villa cocktail party. Zhao Na was sarcastic, while SUKI responded skillfully, showing her wit and courage. The conversation between the two was full of gunpowder, adding wonderful highlights to the story.
Tension in character relationships
The relationship between SUKI and Wu Shiren is complex and delicate, with both the entanglement of interests and the tug - of - war of emotions. Wu Shiren took a fancy to SUKI's talent and tried to control her; SUKI had to deal with him for her mother and her own future. This tense relationship makes the story full of suspense.
Scene features
The story scenes are rich and diverse, from the office of Renhe Capital to the meeting room of Hengtai Capital and then to the private cocktail party at the hilltop villa. Each scene has a unique atmosphere. The cold and depressing office, the fierce confrontation in the meeting room, and the luxurious and lively cocktail party all add a lot to the story.
Immersive experience
Players will follow SUKI's perspective to deeply experience her struggles and choices in the financial workplace. Feel her anxiety about her mother's condition, her complex emotions towards Wu Shiren, and her helplessness and bravery in the power struggle, as if they were in the story.
High - definition visual performance
The game uses high - definition pictures to vividly present the prosperous scenery of Shanghai's Lujiazui, the delicate layout of the office, and the expressions and actions of the characters. Every scene is lifelike, bringing visual enjoyment to players.
Functional gameplay features
The game supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - click backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots, and the automatic playback function allows players to easily enjoy the story. The chapter browsing function enables players to quickly locate the chapters they are interested in. The high - definition CG adds more visual impact to the story, and the smooth reading experience allows players to be immersed in it.

The content is not suitable for minors. It is recommended that adult players experience it.
